# Fawnfell Studio & Products

> Fawnfell is an independent software studio building offline-first learning apps (Executive Reborn), atmospheric narrative games, and open-core project delivery tools (fawnfell/project-delivery).

## Core Pages & Documentation

- [The Day Marshal the Akita Lost His Tail—and Why We Removed Chocolates from Valentine's Day](https://fawnfell.com/articles/akita-marshal-tail-and-valentine-chocolate/index.html): Behind the scenes of Executive Reborn: fixing an 832px clipped Akita tail with --wide padding, editing out dog-toxic chocolates via img2img, packing 13 seasonal rooms under 7 MB, and fixing a Shiba typo.
- [Fawnfell Engineering & Design Devlog](https://fawnfell.com/articles/index.html): Engineering notes and behind-the-scenes devlogs from Fawnfell on latency-based FSRS-6 memory design, Akita character art pipelines, and offline learning apps.
- [秋田犬のしっぽが切れた日、そしてバレンタイン背景からチョコを消した理由](https://fawnfell.com/articles/ja/akita-marshal-tail-and-valentine-chocolate/index.html): 832pxキャンバスで切れた秋田犬Marshalのしっぽ補白、犬に猛毒なチョコ箱の除去、7MB未満に収めた13種の季節窓と2026–2035年中秋テーブル、柴犬誤記修正の舞台裏。
- [Fawnfell 開発日記・設計ノート](https://fawnfell.com/articles/ja/index.html): Fawnfellによる個人開発の設計ノート：反応速度FSRS-6による三日坊主対策や、秋田犬Marshalの立ち絵修正・13種季節窓の制作裏話。
- [なぜ単語アプリは3週間で三日坊主になるのか？「忘れた / 簡単」4択を捨て、回答速度で自動判定するFSRS-6を作った話](https://fawnfell.com/articles/ja/why-flashcard-apps-fail-latency-fsrs/index.html): 夜10時に「忘れた/簡単」ボタンを100回押す疲労をなくすため、個人中央値速度で自動判定するFSRS-6英語アプリ『Executive Reborn』の設計記録。
- [Why Flashcard Apps Fail in 3 Weeks: Replacing 4 Manual Rating Buttons with Reaction-Latency FSRS-6](https://fawnfell.com/articles/why-flashcard-apps-fail-latency-fsrs/index.html): How Executive Reborn eliminates 4-button self-rating fatigue using personal median response latency for FSRS-6, same-episode narrow input, and lifetime free review queues.
- [秋田犬的尾巴被畫框切掉那天，以及我為什麼從情人節背景裡刪掉了巧克力](https://fawnfell.com/articles/zh-tw/akita-marshal-tail-and-valentine-chocolate/index.html): 從 832px 畫布斷尾補白、連夜用圖生圖清掉對犬隻有毒的情人節巧克力盒、7 MB 塞進 13 套四季窗景與十年中秋表，到全站把柴犬誤寫改回秋田犬的真實開發日誌。
- [Fawnfell 開發日誌與設計筆記](https://fawnfell.com/articles/zh-tw/index.html): Fawnfell 獨立開發工程筆記：以反應速度驅動 FSRS-6 解決背單字倦怠，以及秋田犬 Marshal 斷尾修復與情人節去毒巧克力的幕後實錄。
- [為什麼背單字 App 總是撐不過 3 週？我砍掉「忘記 / 簡單」4 個自評按鈕，改用反應速度驅動 FSRS-6](https://fawnfell.com/articles/zh-tw/why-flashcard-apps-fail-latency-fsrs/index.html): 為解決上班族連按 100 次「忘記/簡單」的決策疲勞，《Executive Reborn》改以近 200 題反應速度中位數自動驅動 FSRS-6，並結合單課聽讀循環與永久免費複習佇列。
- [Fawnfell — Calm, Durable Software & Story Worlds](https://fawnfell.com/index.html): Fawnfell is an independent software studio creating offline-first language apps, cozy narrative games, and first-principles developer tools.
- [Fawnfell — 静かで長く使えるアプリと物語を](https://fawnfell.com/ja/index.html): Fawnfell（フォーンフェル）は、オフライン重視の語学学習アプリ、物語ゲーム、開発者向けオープンソースツールを制作する独立ソフトウェアスタジオです。
- [Fawnfell — 오래 곁에 두는 소프트웨어와 이야기](https://fawnfell.com/ko/index.html): Fawnfell은 오프라인 우선 어학 학습 앱, 내러티브 게임, 오픈소스 개발자 도구를 만드는 독립 소프트웨어 스튜디오입니다.
- [Executive Reborn — Learn Real Workplace English Through Story](https://fawnfell.com/products/executive-reborn/index.html): Executive Reborn by Fawnfell is an offline-first business English RPG and FSRS flashcard app with 42 workplace English lessons, 16 mystery side stories, 1,397 workplace phrases, and 11,250 AAC voice clips.
- [Executive Reborn — ドラマ×FSRSで続くビジネス英語](https://fawnfell.com/products/executive-reborn/ja/index.html): Fawnfell の『Executive Reborn』は本編42話のビジネス英語＋番外物語16話、1,397のビジネス表現、11,250本のオフライン音声を備えたビジネス英語学習アプリです。
- [Executive Reborn カリキュラム体験：本編第1〜3話＋Reading全文](https://fawnfell.com/products/executive-reborn/ja/preview/index.html): Executive Reborn 本編第1〜3話の無料試読ページ。取締役会や全社集会のリスニングスクリプト（英日対訳）、社内文書リーディング教材、72語のビジネス表現を確認できます。
- [Executive Reborn — 스토리에 몰입하며 익히는 실전 비즈니스 영어](https://fawnfell.com/products/executive-reborn/ko/index.html): Fawnfell의 Executive Reborn은 본편 42강 비즈니스 영어 + 번외 스토리 16화, 1,397개 비즈니스 표현과 반응 속도 FSRS-6 반복 학습을 담은 오프라인 비즈니스 영어 앱입니다.
- [Executive Reborn 커리큘럼 미리보기: 본편 1–3화 & 리딩 전문](https://fawnfell.com/products/executive-reborn/ko/preview/index.html): Executive Reborn 본편 1–3화 무료 체험 페이지입니다. 이사회·전사 회의 리스닝 스크립트(영한 대역), 사내 문서 리딩 지문 13편, 핵심 비즈니스 어휘 72개를 미리 확인하세요.
- [Executive Reborn — Open Wordlist Licenses & Attribution](https://fawnfell.com/products/executive-reborn/licenses/index.html): Open CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution, modification notes, and downloadable headword lists for TOEIC Service List (TSL 1.2) and New General Service List (NGSL 1.2) used in Executive Reborn.
- [New General Service List (NGSL) 1.2 — 署名与相同方式共享](https://fawnfell.com/products/executive-reborn/licenses/LICENSE-NGSL.md): 来源**：New General Service List v1.2，作者 Dr. Charles Browne、Dr. Brent Culligan、Joseph Phillips（2013）
- [TOEIC Service List (TSL) 1.2 — 署名与相同方式共享](https://fawnfell.com/products/executive-reborn/licenses/LICENSE-TSL.md): 来源**：TOEIC Service List v1.2，作者 Dr. Charles Browne、Dr. Brent Culligan
- [Executive Reborn Curriculum Architecture & Free Sample (EP01–EP03)](https://fawnfell.com/products/executive-reborn/preview/index.html): Read the complete free preview of Executive Reborn Episodes 1–3: boardroom listening scripts, 10 workplace reading memos, 72 curated TSL/NGSL phrases, and pricing.
- [Executive Reborn — Privacy Policy](https://fawnfell.com/products/executive-reborn/privacy/index.html): Bilingual English and Japanese privacy policy for Executive Reborn by Fawnfell. Local-first learning progress, Apple App Store / RevenueCat receipt handling, and zero ad tracking.
- [Executive Reborn — Support & Help](https://fawnfell.com/products/executive-reborn/support/index.html): Official support page for Executive Reborn by Fawnfell. How to restore purchases, manage subscriptions, switch languages, and contact support at fawnfell@gmail.com.
- [Executive Reborn — 邊追職場懸疑劇邊練商務英語](https://fawnfell.com/products/executive-reborn/zh-tw/index.html): Fawnfell 出品的《Executive Reborn》收錄 42 集商務英語主線與 16 話懸疑番外、1,397 條商務片語與反應時間 FSRS-6 引擎，支援純離線通勤學習。
- [Executive Reborn 課程架構與免費試讀（第 1–3 集全文）](https://fawnfell.com/products/executive-reborn/zh-tw/preview/index.html): 免安裝線上試讀《Executive Reborn》正篇第 1–3 集：含董事會與全員大會聽力逐字稿（英繁雙語）、13 篇職場閱讀文件與 72 條商務核心詞彙。
